cause: A cropped filter source reused its capture/source bounds as the native paint clip-classification domain. A fractional clip can enclose that crop while still clipping its parent picture, selecting different paint alpha arithmetic.
correction: Propagate the existing parent-picture clip domain into both source capture routes, translating it into capture coordinates. Classify ordinary rectangle clips and active viewport clips against that domain. Keep allocation, request, construction and sample origins separate; remove the superseded one-caller polygon helper.
